evals.name: messy-manifest-mi-processor
evals.prompt: Driver leaves at 2pm. Attached: sales order SO-1042, our draft manifest, and this morning's Metrc active packages. We're a Michigan processor shipping to a provisioning center. Anything we need to fix?
evals.expected_output: Runs detect-only, shows distinct lab values (SubmittedForTesting, TestFailed, TestPassed) and asks or states which count as passed before final results; overall HOLD; flags Gummies ...205 (TestFailed, not on order) and Rosin ...207 (SubmittedForTesting, duplicate tag) to be pulled, pre-roll ...204 exceeding on hand (60 vs 48) and order (50), Blue Dream ...202 as unit-conversion rounding (2268 g vs 5 lb = 2267.96 g), cart ...203 order mismatch (30 vs 24), ...206 not in inventory, tincture ...208 missing from manifest; fixes grouped by owner; manual-verify list including receiver license status; no invented Michigan manifest fields or transport rules.
assertions: Overall result is HOLD
Confirms with the user (or explicitly states the assumption) which lab-status values count as passed rather than silently assuming
Identifies packages ...205 and ...207 as not passed / not shippable
Identifies ...204 manifest quantity 60 exceeding on-hand 48
Explains the Blue Dream 2268 g vs 5 lb (2267.96 g) rounding issue and tells them to restate in the package's unit
Flags ...208 as ordered but missing from the manifest
Includes a manual-verification list covering receiver license status and driver/vehicle/route fields
Does not state specific Michigan manifest field or transport requirements without a citation

evals.name: clean-manifest-sku-join
evals.prompt: quick sanity check on SO-1043 before it ships - order, manifest and inventory export attached. testpassed is our only passing status. CA distributor.
evals.expected_output: Joins order to manifest by SKU, finds no file-based issues, returns 'GO on file checks' with manual checks still required, and does not call the shipment compliant.
assertions: Result is GO on file checks with both lines GO
States that manual checks (license status, driver/vehicle/route, labeling) are still required
Does not use the word 'compliant' to describe the shipment
Includes a jurisdiction block naming California and leaves unverified CA transport rules as NEEDS VERIFICATION

evals.name: missing-inventory-and-state
evals.prompt: Can you check this manifest against the invoice? Want to make sure we're good to send it out.
evals.expected_output: Asks in one combined message for the state, license types, the active package inventory export with lab status (and the files if not attached); explains that without inventory it cannot check lab status or on-hand; does not produce a GO.
assertions: Asks for the active package inventory export including lab/testing status
Asks for state and license types in one combined question
Does not give an overall GO without inventory and lab status
May run order-vs-manifest comparison but labels it as partial

evals.name: regression-blank-units-duplicate-inventory
evals.prompt: Truck leaves at 3. SO-2051, the draft manifest and today's Metrc active packages are attached. TestPassed is our only passing status. Michigan processor shipping to a provisioning center. Some cells in these exports are blank, sorry.
evals.expected_output: Overall HOLD with 5 of 6 lines on HOLD and only ...404 GO on file checks. ...401 is MISSING_UNIT (manifest unit blank; quantity not compared and no unit taken from the order or inventory). ...402 ships 100.3 g against a 100 g package and a 100 g order: EXCEEDS_ON_HAND and ORDER_QTY_MISMATCH, not rounding. ...403 is DUPLICATE_INVENTORY_TAG, with both inventory rows (50 Each TestPassed, 10 Each TestFailed) listed and neither row assumed current. ...405 (2268 g vs 5 lb) is UNIT_CONVERSION_ROUNDING and ORDER_QTY_ROUNDING, to restate in pounds. ...406 is INVENTORY_UNIT_MISSING (inventory unit blank, on-hand not compared). An Input problems section lists all four input_problems entries, including the blank-tag inventory row 7, and says they keep the overall result at HOLD. Manual-verify list and sign-off are included.
assertions: Overall result is HOLD with only ...404 shown as GO on file checks
Holds ...401 for a missing manifest unit and does not compare its quantity using the order's or inventory's unit
Treats ...402 (100.3 g vs a 100 g package) as exceeding on hand and an order mismatch, not as unit-conversion rounding
Holds ...403 because the tag appears twice in inventory, lists both rows' quantity and lab status (50 Each TestPassed, 10 Each TestFailed), and does not pick one
Explains ...405 as unit-conversion rounding (2268 g vs 5 lb = 2267.96 g) and says to restate it in pounds
Holds ...406 because the inventory unit is blank
Includes an Input problems section that reports the blank-tag inventory row 7 and every other input_problems entry
